# nb-studio report

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## report attention

Get what needs attention

The exceptions now: issues in Blocked, issues past their due date, pull requests open longer than two days, and runs on issues that failed in the last 24 hours and were not retried; each list holds its total and the first five. Needs the reports grant (page `reports`); counts every run with `agents.agents` `read`, otherwise the caller’s own, and only issues the caller may see.

```bash
nb-studio report attention
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/reports/attention` (`reportsGetAttention`)

## report dashboard

Get the dashboard report

The last `days` days up to today (UTC), against the days before them: delivery, the agents' performance, day by day and by project. Needs the reports grant (page `reports`); counts every run with `agents.agents` `read`, otherwise the caller’s own, and only issues the caller may see.

```bash
nb-studio report dashboard
```

| Flag     | Type   | Description  |
| -------- | ------ | ------------ |
| `--days` | number | (default 30) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/reports/dashboard` (`reportsGetDashboard`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio report dashboard --days 7
```

## report metrics

Get the acceptance metrics

Needs the reports grant (page `reports`); counts every run with `agents.agents` `read`, otherwise the caller’s own, and only issues the caller may see. `meta.message` words the figures for a reader. An agent's run reads them for the person who woke it when its agent may read reports.

```bash
nb-studio report metrics
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                      |
| ----------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--from`    | string | The first day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); 30 days before `to` by default. |
| `--to`      | string | The last day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); today by default.                |
| `--project` | string | Only this project's issues and runs (its id).                    |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `studio.reports/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/reports/metrics` (`reportsGetMetrics`)

## report usage

Get what agents’ runs used and cost

Grouped by agent, person, project, issue, day, model, tool or type. Needs the reports grant (page `reports`); counts every run with `agents.agents` `read`, otherwise the caller’s own, and only issues the caller may see. `meta.message` words the figures for a reader. An agent's run reads them for the person who woke it when its agent may read reports.

```bash
nb-studio report usage
```

| Flag         | Type     | Description                                                      |
| ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--from`     | string   | The first day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); 30 days before `to` by default. |
| `--to`       | string   | The last day, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); today by default.                |
| `--project`  | string   | Only this project's issues and runs (its id).                    |
| `--group-by` | agent \\ | person \\                                                        | project \\ | issue \\ | day \\ | model \\ | tool \\ | type | (default "agent") |
| `--agent`    | string   | Only this agent's runs (its id).                                 |
| `--user`     | string   | Only the runs this person started (their user id).               |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `studio.reports/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/reports/usage` (`reportsGetUsage`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio report usage --group-by model --from 2026-09-01
```
